title: ExamLeaf Golden Set (gs/) v1
description: Registry kind gs/ (CE-63): the locale-and-family passage set a voice is tested on (GL-voice, golden-set runs). Not an EPP pin; it reaches artefacts only through the voice entry's golden_set record (resolver-08). Passage text and reference audio live in the private store; only hashes are here. See subsystems/VOICE_and_PERSONA_REGISTRY.md §3.6 (added 15 Oct 2026, voice-12).
$comment: Commercial-term lint (CE-L1/RD-49; CE-26, CE-70; 15 Oct 2026): CI rejects, case-insensitively, any match of (price|pricing|paid|is_free|free_|premium|entitle|subscri|sku|paywall|unlock|monetis|monetiz|revenue|discount|coupon|tier|destination_resource|cta_destination|funnel|purchase_|checkout_|product_id|offer_|trial_|utm_|campaign_|affiliate_|activation_code|storefront) applied to every object key at every depth, every required entry, pattern key and enum or const value. Exempt: series_position, flagship and demo_kind.
